This installer has not yet run on any device. Every device step is unverified until lab test Q-INST-06 is certified.
Removing 'language python3' ('delete system scripts language') stops every unsigned Python script on this device from running, not only J-Wicket.
Removing netconf ssh ('delete system services netconf ssh') stops new NETCONF sessions to this device and may end every open one (unverified, lab test Q-INST-05), including tools that started using it after J-Wicket was installed.

Unit 2B (device-configuration): stage uninstall: the configuration change
Status: statements: see each line's status in Spec 006 section 7.3
```
delete system scripts language
delete system extensions extension-service application file jwicket_selftest.py
delete system extensions extension-service application file jwicket_probe.py
delete system extensions extension-service application file jwicket.py
show | compare | no-more
```
STOP unless 'show | compare' shows exactly these statements and nothing else. Junos prints each change under the deepest level that already exists, and a new level as a braced block; the grouping below is rendered from the configuration the installer read, a select-only read, so a level it cannot see may make Junos print a deeper header for the same statements (illustrative; real samples are recorded by lab test Q-INST-01):
    [edit system]
    -    scripts {
    -        language python3;
    -    }
    -    extensions {
    -        extension-service {
    -            application {
    -                file jwicket_selftest.py {
    -                    checksum {
    -                        sha-256 1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f;
    -                    }
    -                    username labadmin;
    -                }
    -                file jwicket_probe.py {
    -                    checksum {
    -                        sha-256 1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f;
    -                    }
    -                    username labadmin;
    -                }
    -                file jwicket.py {
    -                    checksum {
    -                        sha-256 1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f;
    -                    }
    -                    daemonize;
    -                    respawn-on-normal-exit;
    -                    username labadmin;
    -                }
    -            }
    -        }
    -    }
If it shows anything else, type 'rollback 0' and 'exit'.

Compare with what each check expects:
C12: The removed statements are absent from the committed configuration.
    expect the removed statements to be gone
C10: Before confirming: the committed statements of the touched subtrees equal the plan, and the committed delta ('show | compare rollback 1') changes nothing outside them.
    expect 'show | compare rollback 1' to show only the change of unit B
C11: Before confirming: 'show system commit' shows this stage's commit as the newest, by the daemon account, with this stage's comment, and no 'commit at' or prepared commit.

Leave at least one minute before the deadline. Only if all of that matches, paste the next unit.

Unit 5 (device-operational): delete J-Wicket's files
Status: 'file delete' verified (F10); every name is one of J-Wicket's fixed names
```
file delete /var/db/jwicket/audit.jsonl
file delete /var/db/jwicket/install-receipt.json
file delete /var/db/jwicket/jwicket.ini
file delete /var/db/jwicket/jwicket.log
file delete /var/db/jwicket/probe-result.json
file delete /var/db/jwicket/selftest-result.json
file delete /var/db/jwicket/tls.crt
file delete /var/db/jwicket/tls.key
file delete /var/db/scripts/jet/jwicket.py
file delete /var/db/scripts/jet/jwicket_probe.py
file delete /var/db/scripts/jet/jwicket_selftest.py
```

The uninstaller leaves /var/db/jwicket itself: its account cannot remove an entry of /var/db, as it could not create one (inferred from the verified refusal). Once 'file list /var/db/jwicket detail' shows nothing of J-Wicket's, in a shell on the lab device as root: 'rmdir /var/db/jwicket' (it refuses a directory that is not empty; unverified).
In a shell on the lab device as root:
Unit 6 (device-shell): the empty state directory, as root
Status: outside Juniper support; unverified (its counterpart, the root step that made it, verified on SRX4100 25.2R1-S1.4)
```
rmdir /var/db/jwicket
```

Not removed by this tool: lab accounts or login classes created by hand ('system login'), 'system services ssh allow-tcp-forwarding' or 'tcp-forwarding', whichever you added (deploy-lab step 7), and the device's rollback history ('show system rollback'), which still holds the old J-Wicket statements.
